summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K on August 7, 2026, to attach a legal opinion and consent from Skadden, Arps regarding a prospectus supplement for the resale of 13,615,979 common shares issued to Evervolt Green Energy Holding Pte. Ltd. as consideration for an IP purchase. The company receives no proceeds; Evervolt may sell shares. This is a routine SEC filing supporting a registration statement, not a special-situation event.
